# 1. fix the doc splice in method_pass.rs
p='src/types/checker/method_pass.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = """    /// "must return a value on every path" coverage check.
    /// Re-types a method's BY-REFERENCE array parameters"""
new = """    /// "must return a value on every path" coverage check.
    ///
    /// ---
    ///
    /// Re-types a method's BY-REFERENCE array parameters"""
assert s.count(old)==1
lines = s.split('\n')
# find the start of the orphaned doc block preceding my fn
target = "    fn update_method_by_ref_param_types("
ti = next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(target))
start = ti
while start > 0 and lines[start-1].lstrip().startswith('///'):
    start -= 1
# the previous doc block ends where the "Without that short-circuit" paragraph ends
split_at = next(i for i in range(start, ti) if lines[i].strip().startswith('/// Re-types a method'))
prev_doc = lines[start:split_at]
my_doc = lines[split_at:ti]
# find the item the previous doc belongs to
rest = lines[:start] + my_doc + lines[ti:]
# reattach prev_doc before the next fn after my function
end_of_mine = next(i for i in range(len(rest)) if rest[i].startswith("    fn update_method_by_ref_param_types("))
depth_end = end_of_mine
brace = 0
started = False
while depth_end < len(rest):
    brace += rest[depth_end].count('{') - rest[depth_end].count('}')
    if '{' in rest[depth_end]:
        started = True
    if started and brace == 0:
        break
    depth_end += 1
insert_at = depth_end + 2
out = rest[:insert_at] + prev_doc + rest[insert_at:]
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
print('doc splice fixed in method_pass.rs')
